knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Clay removes embedded contamination on a lubricated surface. It does not remove swirls, which need polishing.
A dropped clay carries grit and is discarded.
A medium grade is more aggressive, and marring from it needs polishing to remove.

practicalCriteria: Touch-tests a sample panel, identifies the rough areas, and maps them on the record.
Clays one lubricated section of about 45 centimetres square with a fine-grade clay, reshaping the clay as it loads.
Discards a simulated dropped clay and records the drop.
passRule: Touch test recorded, one section clayed with lubrication and reshaping, and dropped clay discarded. Observed by an assessor. A quiz pass is not a practical pass.
evidenceRequired: Record of the clay section and any drop
stopWorkCriteria: Chemical decontaminant used on a coated finish without label approval
